resources.string: Provider file tools are not available in this session yet. Your workspace files stay open and editable.
No provider sources are linked to this workspace yet.
No linked provider file for this path. Import one first.
Waiting on a provider recovery. Release stays disabled until it is reconciled.
The provider session for this file expired. Re-pick it to restore access.
This pick is session-only: access ends when the app stops until you pick again.
Choose an available file or folder in the system picker. Some protected folders cannot be selected.
Pick a provider file or folder first, then choose where it lands in the workspace.
Save As never overwrites any provider file. Pick a new file name; the system creates a distinct document and the workspace copy is sent into it.
The original provider file stays untouched.
Export a copy to a folder
Pick the destination folder, then export. A new document is created; nothing is replaced.
First choose the folder with Choose folder…, then browse it here. Browsing picks one file; Import on a chosen folder brings its files in.
Virtual item — only the provider renderings can be copied (%1$s).
Provider access: read + write, kept after restart.
Provider access: read + write, for this session only.
Provider access: read-only, kept after restart.
Provider access: read-only, for this session only.
Recovery state: %1$s. Nothing was deleted; reconcile decides it from the actual content from the provider.
Imported and linked to the workspace.
Saved: the provider read-back confirmed the new bytes.
The provider or the granted access is read-only here. Use Save As or Export instead.
The provider cannot do this for that item. Choose another file or a folder destination.
Files larger than 1 GiB are not copied through the workspace.
The provider did not confirm the change. Nothing was overwritten; the recovery copy is kept for Reconcile.
The provider file changed since it was linked. Nothing was overwritten — re-import or use Save As.
A different file already exists at that path. Choose another path or use Save.
The workspace journal refused this step. Nothing was overwritten; refresh and try again.
The provider says this file no longer exists.
The provider is offline. The workspace journal keeps this item pending — reconcile restores it when the provider returns.
Kept: other parts of Floe still use this access, so nothing was released.
The operation did not complete. Your workspace files are intact. Try again.
